name: Berberosaurus
isnote: Original description called it a basal abelisauroid; later analyses place it among ceratosaurs or neotheropods; Wikipedia says possibly a ceratosaur.
sum: Toarcian neotheropod from the Azilal Formation of Morocco, possibly a ceratosaur.
holotype: Not given in the sources used.
